ideas.pitch: An offline quantum program design optimizer that translates suboptimal Qiskit circuits into depth-reduced equivalents using heuristic rewriting.
ideas.title: QiskitCircuitRefiner
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns directly with the Qiskit Fall Fest theme of Program Design by solving a tangible quantum developer pain point (circuit depth reduction) that appeals to Qiskit-focused judges.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight standalone program design workspace that interactively visualizes qubit entanglement and state vector evolution in real time as code is written.
ideas.title: EntanglementVisualizerIDE
ideas.why_it_could_win: Judges at a Qiskit event value developer tooling that makes quantum programming more intuitive and transparent for beginners and experts alike.

ideas.pitch: A command-line tool for program design that injects error-mitigation wrappers like zero-noise extrapolation into arbitrary Qiskit circuits before execution.
ideas.title: QuantumErrorMitigationCLI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates deep technical understanding of near-term quantum computing limitations, checking the genuinely hard engineering box favored by technical judges.

ideas.pitch: A modular program design framework for structuring variational quantum eigensolver (VQE) pipelines with pluggable classical optimizers.
ideas.title: HybridAlgorithmBlueprint
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides a reusable architecture for hybrid quantum-classical workflows, addressing a major bottleneck in practical quantum software development.

ideas.pitch: An automated program design testing assistant that generates unit tests and assertion bounds for Qiskit quantum circuits based on expected unitary matrices.
ideas.title: QiskitUnitTestScaffolder
ideas.why_it_could_win: Software engineering practices are rarely applied to quantum code, making a rigorous testing tool stand out for its practical utility in program design.
